title: Get Out (Tuco)
blurb: GET OUT — Tuco Salamanca's unhinged scream from Breaking Bad, extracted by TikTok and turned into the definitive ejection sound. It plays when anyone or anything needs to leave immediately: bad takes, intrusive thoughts, the wrong answer in a quiz. The delivery is so violently final that it works on literally any subject. One of the most searched meme sounds right now.
origin: Tuco Salamanca's scream from Breaking Bad, viral on TikTok as the universal ejection sound.
